usage.summary: Use `good-detail-list` for compact label/value pairs in summaries, settings, and price breakdowns. It renders a native `<dl>`. Add one `<div goodDetailRow>` per pair, with a native `<dt>` for the label and `<dd>` for the value. The value aligns to the right; long content wraps within narrow panels. The list has no border or page-specific padding.
